narrative.intro: TriWest Healthcare Alliance has $900M in federal contract obligations in FY2027 to date. TriWest received 3 awards so far this fiscal year, with an average award size of $300M. Obligations are down 94.6% year over year. Fiscal-year trends show obligations of $7.4B in FY22, $8B in FY23, $8.4B in FY24, $13.4B in FY25, $16.6B in FY26, and $900M in FY27. Direct Health and Medical Insurance Carriers accounts for $900M of FY2027 to date obligations. Pharmacy Benefit Management and Other Third Party Administration of Insurance and Pension Funds accounts for $0 in FY2027 to date obligations. Current-year totals are partial, described as fiscal year to date, and the figures shown are contract obligations except where noted otherwise in award-value tables.
